observations.description: The palm appears broad and fairly rectangular, with long, slender fingers.
Fingers are long and relatively straight; the thumb is held open at a wide angle from the palm.
A relatively clear upper transverse line is visible below the fingers, running across the palm with a slight curve.
A prominent diagonal line runs across the middle of the palm, slanting downward toward the outer edge.
A curved line arcs around the base of the thumb, extending from the area between thumb and index finger down toward the wrist.
observations.location: Around the base of the thumb

observations.description: A faint vertical line is visible rising through the center-lower palm toward the middle of the hand.
The mount at the base of the thumb appears moderately full.
The outer lower palm appears moderately developed and rounded.
Several fine intersecting lines and small branches cross the central palm, including intersections near the head and fate line region.
A metallic ring is visible on the ring finger.
The face appears oval with a relatively balanced width-to-height ratio and a gently rounded jawline.
Forehead, midface, and lower face are all clearly visible; the forehead looks moderately tall, the midface is moderate in length, and the lower face appears shorter than the upper zones.
The eyes are visible and appear lightly hooded with a calm, level gaze.
The nose appears straight and moderate in width and projection.
The mouth is closed with a relatively straight lip line; the chin appears rounded and modest in size.
The palm appears broad with a relatively wide base and a rectangular overall hand shape.
The upper zone (fingers) is long relative to the palm, the middle zone (palm) is moderate in length, and the lower zone (wrist/base) is clearly visible and narrower than the palm.
The thumb is spread outward at a wide angle from the palm and looks sturdy with a rounded tip.
observations.location: left side of the hand in the image

observations.description: The fingers are long and slender, with the middle finger tallest and the little finger noticeably shorter.
Prominent palm creases are visible across the center of the palm, including a deep diagonal line and multiple intersecting fine lines.
